decontamination_notes: Real feature from pallets/click PR #3581 (discussion #3527), merged 2026-07-08, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Adds custom_version_option to src/click/decorators.py (an eager, non-exposed flag option whose callback builds the whole version string from the Context, echoed with ctx.color and followed by ctx.exit()) and exports it from src/click/__init__.py (multi_file); version_option's parameter set is declared frozen. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (16fc00e2) to src/click + pyproject.toml + LICENSE (click is dependency-free on Linux; base sandbox image, PYTHONPATH=src; the workspace copy shadows any site-packages click). Coverage: 4 fail_to_pass tests via click.testing.CliRunner, each verified failing at base (the attribute does not exist) and passing after the gold patch — callback output printed with exit 0 and the body not run, custom parameter declarations, the callback receiving the Context (prog_name visible via info_name), and eagerness beating a missing required argument; 3 pass_to_pass guards pin version_option, plain option parsing, and help rendering. Output assertions use the tests' own strings, never library error text.
